description: Search the register of medicines authorised in Poland by brand name or active substance, prescription and non-prescription, like the /lek catalog on apteka.online. Returns slug, substance, strength, form, prescription (rx or otc), refunded and sold_online; use get_medicine, get_medicine_document or get_refund_prices with the slug. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice. Medicine data comes from the Polish register of medicinal products (RPL) and the Ministry of Health refund announcement: prescription medicines are shown for information only and are not sold online, and refund prices are official maximum prices, not apteka.online prices.
